title: Degree-counted local splitting at a point of an étale-site object
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be an étale morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-etale-morphism] finite locally free of degree $d\in\mathbf N$ [def-pc-finite-locally-free]. For every object $W\to X$ of the small étale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and $w\in W$, there exist another site object $V$, a site morphism $a:V\to W$, a point $v\in V$ with $a(v)=w$, schemes $D_j$ indexed by $j\in\operatorname{Fin}(d)$, and maps $i_j:D_j\to Y\times_X V$ [def-pc-fibre-product] forming a coproduct cofan. Each $i_j$ is an open and closed immersion [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-closed-immersion], and $i_j$ followed by the projection to $V$ is an isomorphism. The empty index set is allowed.

source.place: Tag 04HN (lemma-finite-etale-etale-local) in etale.tex; geometric-degree count in etale-cohomology.tex, Tag 03SH (section-trace-method) after Definition 03SE

proof.text: Apply finite_etale_etale_local_split to p = pullback.snd f W.hom at w. This gives g : U → W.left, v over w, a finite type J, and a clopen colimiting cofan over pullback p g whose component projections to U are isomorphisms.

Apply fiberDegree_eq_nat_card_of_split_cofan to pullback.snd p g and v. Its fibre degree is Nat.card J. Apply Scheme.Hom.fiberDegree_of_isPullback twice and the prescribed IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfDegree.fiberDegree_eq to conclude Nat.card J = d. This uses the ordinary residue field, with no algebraic closure or geometric fibre.

Set V = Scheme.Etale.mk (g ≫ W.hom) and a = MorphismProperty.Over.homMk g rfl. Transport the cofan along pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso f W.hom g using Cofan.ext and IsColimit.ofIsoColimit. Reindex by the equivalence ULift (Fin d) ≃ J obtained from the cardinal equality, using Cofan.isColimitEquivOfEquiv. Composition with the pasting isomorphism preserves open and closed immersions, and pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso_hom_snd preserves the component projections. The point equality is the original equality g v = w. The construction includes d = 0.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtale_degree_split_at
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) [Etale f]
    (d : ℕ) [f.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfDegree d]
    (W : X.Etale) (w : W.left) :
    ∃ (V : X.Etale) (a : V ⟶ W) (v : V.left),
      a.left v = w ∧
      ∃ (D : ULift.{u} (Fin d) → Scheme.{u}) (i : ∀ j, D j ⟶ pullback f V.hom),
        Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk (pullback f V.hom) i)) ∧
        (∀ j, IsOpenImmersion (i j) ∧ IsClosedImmersion (i j)) ∧
        (∀ j, IsIso (i j ≫ pullback.snd f V.hom))
